title: Abolition of special funds; legislative purpose.
partHeading: PART III. BUDGETARY CONTROL OF SPECIAL FUNDS
bodyText: The purpose of this part is to place all special funds under legislative and executive budgetary control in the same manner as the general fund, with the exception of those funds subject to applicable federal laws or regulations and payments on principal and interest on revenue bonds.
crossReferences: Special and revolving fund reviews, see §§23-11 and 23-12.
